term._comment: Canonical Jason-bet term sheet (b0nd battle test). Cardone vs Calacanis, same-asset form: $ vs $ (USDC).
term.claim: BTC-USD/btcusd 1-minute candle high reaches or exceeds $126,210.50 on BOTH Coinbase and Bitstamp within the same 5-minute window, on or before 2028-10-28T19:00:00Z (the term sheet pins UTC; 'October 28, 2028, 12PM PST' is ambiguous between a literal PST reading of 20:00Z and the correct PDT-adjusted 19:00Z -- see custom_definitions).

elements.q: Do the exhibits show a Coinbase candle with high >= 126210.50 before 2028-10-28T19:00:00Z UTC AND a Bitstamp candle with high >= 126210.50 in the same 5-minute window, also before the deadline?

custom_definitions: 'Hits or exceeds $126,210.50' means a 1-minute candle HIGH (the wick), not the close, reaches or exceeds 126210.50 USD; a lower close in the same candle does not undo a qualifying high.

The trigger requires confirmation on BOTH Coinbase (BTC-USD) and Bitstamp (btcusd) within the SAME 5-minute window (the two 1-minute candles' timestamps floor to the same 5-minute bucket); a high on only one of the two listed sources, or on the two sources in different 5-minute windows, does not satisfy the element.

Deadline is 2028-10-28T19:00:00Z UTC exactly (12:00 PDT on 2028-10-28; DST is in effect, so the literal 'PST' in the original wording is corrected to its intended PDT clock time and pinned here as UTC, never evaluated against the literal string 'PST').
If the trigger has not occurred by the deadline, the outcome is NO; early YES resolution is allowed at the first qualifying confirmed window, never before.

Fallback: if one of Coinbase or Bitstamp is unavailable (no admissible exhibit for that source reaches the evidence cutoff), the remaining source of the pair AND Kraken (XBT/USD) must BOTH independently confirm a qualifying high within the same 5-minute window for the trigger to fire; if fewer than two of {Coinbase, Bitstamp, Kraken} can be checked at all, the outcome is VOID with full refunds.

Only USD-quoted pairs on the three named venues (Coinbase BTC-USD, Bitstamp btcusd, Kraken XBT/USD) are eligible; price-aggregator sites (e.g. CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko), USDT-quoted pairs on any venue, and any exchange not named here are never eligible sources, even if they report a qualifying price.

Fork rule: 'Bitcoin' means whichever asset each named exchange itself lists under its own BTC/XBT ticker at the time of the observation; a hard fork or rename that causes an exchange to redirect its ticker does not change which ticker is read, and does not retroactively apply to candles observed before the redirect.

The pinned verifier is Claude Haiku (claude:haiku) via the attested backend, with an ordered fallback list [claude:haiku, claude:sonnet] if the pinned verifier is unavailable; a verifier that cannot be attested is never substituted silently.
Burden of proof is on YES: an element that is not proven, or is ambiguous on the admitted evidence, resolves NO, never YES by default.

sources.text: Coinbase BTC-USD 1-minute candles on 2026-11-04 show an intraday session high of $100,900.00; no 1-minute candle on this venue has reached or exceeded $126,210.50 at any point up to this timestamp.
Bitstamp btcusd 1-minute candles on 2026-11-04 show an intraday session high of $100,850.00; no 1-minute candle on this venue has reached or exceeded $126,210.50 at any point up to this timestamp.
